numerical_method.coordinate: u = z/z_H in [0, 1] with exact endpoints
numerical_method.independent_checks: twice-denser barycentric equations, Einstein constraint, Maxwell flux, source exact fields, and source thermodynamics
numerical_method.initialization: neutral analytic solution, theta-secant charge continuation, and lower-to-higher degree interpolation; charged exact fields are never solver seeds
numerical_method.nonlinear_solver: scipy.optimize.root(method='hybr', xtol=1e-11), then at most thirty-two scipy.optimize.least_squares(method='trf') evaluations only after a failed root or a scaled root residual above 1e-9; the owner-approved method-conditioned final acceptance ceiling is 2e-8
